title: App Template
summary: Template of a native full-screen app, for developers (never published).
description: Shows every shared widget, the on-screen keyboard rule and a background command. Write your descriptor like this: a summary line of at most 80 characters, then what the app does, its main features and what it needs (keyboard, USB dongle, network); summary and description at most 500 characters together. The launcher shows only this; the long documentation goes in the app's README.
